artifact_metadata.title: Guardian Alpha V30 Stage 2F - Disputed-Claim Correction Register

disputed_claims.topic: Leveraged ETF Nominal and Economic Allocation
disputed_claims.original_statement: QLD + SSO represents 30% of nominal capital, delivering 60% embedded equity notional and 130% gross economic exposure during Risk-On.
disputed_claims.source_of_truth_inspection: agent.py lines 228-235: base_budget = 0.76 if overlay_on else 0.92; weights['QLD'] = 0.11; weights['SSO'] = 0.07.
disputed_claims.residual_and_delta: Overstatement of nominal overlay allocation by +12.00% (reported 30.0% vs true 18.0%); overstatement of target gross exposure by +18.00% (reported 130.0% vs true 112.0%).
disputed_claims.root_cause: Stage 2E adopted a simplified hypothetical model (15% QLD + 15% SSO) in theoretical commentary without verifying against agent.py code.
disputed_claims.corrected_wording: In Risk-On mode with overlay active, Guardian Alpha targets 11.0% QLD and 7.0% SSO (18.0% combined nominal overlay) alongside 76.0% single-stock tech equities and a 6.0% target cash buffer. With 2x embedded ETF leverage, target gross economic index exposure is 112.0% (0.76 + 2 * 0.18), with price drift lifting peak observed gross exposure to 1.167x in Tier 2 and 1.179x in Tier 1. Broker margin borrowing is strictly $0.00.
disputed_claims.confidence: 100.0% (Verified directly against frozen agent.py AST and daily simulation traces)

disputed_claims.topic: Euler Volatility Risk Contribution of Leveraged Overlay
disputed_claims.original_statement: The 30% nominal overlay capital allocation generates 52.2% of the portfolio's total volatility risk.
disputed_claims.source_of_truth_inspection: Euler marginal volatility decomposition PRC_i = (w_i * (Sigma @ w)_i) / (w' Sigma w) evaluated under authentic target weights [0.11, 0.07, 0.152, 0.152, 0.152, 0.152, 0.152] using empirical daily return covariance from tiingo_cache/tier2_bars.json.
disputed_claims.residual_and_delta: Discrepancy of -37.60% (pre-crash window) or -24.66% (full Tier 2). Reported 52.2% was an artifact of fictitious 30% weight vector and synthetic covariance.
disputed_claims.root_cause: Stage 2E used a non-empirical hypothetical covariance matrix with 30% nominal overlay weights.
disputed_claims.corrected_wording: Under authentic 18.0% target overlay weights, the leveraged ETF overlay generates 14.60% of portfolio variance during the pre-crash 2020 Risk-On window and 27.54% across all 283 Tier 2 overlay sessions. Direct single-stock equities generate between 72.46% and 85.40% of portfolio volatility risk.
disputed_claims.confidence: 100.0% (Empirical covariance calculated from authentic price bars)

disputed_claims.original_statement: During the 31.75% Tier 2 drawdown, the 30% nominal overlay contributed 14.19 percentage points (44.69% of the drawdown), while single-stock equities contributed 15.11 percentage points (47.59%).
disputed_claims.source_of_truth_inspection: Daily portfolio mark-to-market and fill log inspection from peak (2020-02-19, NAV $125,556.68) to trough (2020-03-23, NAV $85,691.40). Total dollar drawdown = $39,865.28 (31.7508%).
disputed_claims.residual_and_delta: Discrepancy of -39.28 percentage points in overlay drawdown share (reported 44.69% vs realized 5.41%). Defensive holdings (XLE, XLP, XLU, XLV) suffered 74.49% of the drawdown.
disputed_claims.root_cause: Stage 2E failed to check fill logs, ignoring the fact that the 200 SMA rule liquidated QLD and SSO on 2020-02-25 after only 4 sessions of drawdown, and attributed the subsequent crash of defensive sectors (notably XLE which crashed 54.5%) to the overlay.
disputed_claims.corrected_wording: In realized additive P&L attribution across the March 2020 drawdown (2020-02-19 to 2020-03-23, $39,865.28 decline), the leveraged overlay (QLD + SSO) contributed only $2,156.18 (5.41% of total drawdown), having been liquidated on 2020-02-25. The single-stock equity sleeve contributed $8,011.90 (20.10%). The remaining $29,697.20 (74.49%) was generated by defensive sector holdings (XLE, XLP, XLU, XLV) held between Feb 25 and March 23.
disputed_claims.confidence: 100.0% (Reconstructed from exact daily transaction and mark-to-market ledger)

disputed_claims.topic: Deflated Sharpe Ratio and Multiple Testing Haircut
disputed_claims.original_statement: DSR of 0.52 (p-value 0.48); multiple testing haircut 62% resulting in selection-adjusted Sharpe 0.62.
disputed_claims.source_of_truth_inspection: Bailey & López de Prado (2014) DSR formula and Harvey, Liu, & Zhu (2016) haircut model evaluated on Tier 2 daily return moments (N=504, daily mean=0.001844, daily std=0.017972, skew=-0.4652, kurt=6.1771, annualized Sharpe=1.6286).
disputed_claims.residual_and_delta: DSR value refined from 0.521 to 0.507 under exact unrounded moments. Haircut corrected from a single point estimate (62%) to a sensitivity interval (38% to 62%) reflecting trial correlation.
disputed_claims.root_cause: Stage 2E presented the most conservative extreme (independent trials M=43) as a single point estimate rather than a sensitivity interval accounting for candidate correlation.
disputed_claims.corrected_wording: Under the Bailey & López de Prado (2014) DSR framework, testing M=43 independent trials produces an expected maximum Sharpe of 1.6157, yielding a DSR cumulative probability of 0.5070 (50.7%) and p-value of 0.4930. When accounting for cross-candidate correlation (effective M between 15 and 28), DSR ranges from 0.56 to 0.68. Under Harvey-Liu-Zhu multiple testing adjustments, the haircut ranges from 38% to 62%, yielding a selection-adjusted Sharpe interval of [0.62, 1.01].
